scripts.deploy: gcloud storage rsync ./dist gs://webdevelop.fr --recursive --delete-unmatched-destination-objects && npm run set-cache
scripts.set-cache: gcloud storage objects update gs://webdevelop.fr/**/*.html --cache-control='no-cache, no-store, max-age=0, must-revalidate' && gcloud storage objects update gs://webdevelop.fr/_astro/* --cache-control='public, max-age=31536000, immutable'
